claims.text: Wt loss and correction of insulin resistance lessen hyperkeratotic lesions
claims.quote: In some patients, weight loss and correction of insulin resistance lower the burden of hyperkeratotic lesions.

claims.text: Insulin resistance-associated AN: insulin-sensitizing drugs such as metformin
claims.quote: Acanthosis nigricans associated with insulin resistance can be treated with drugs such as metformin and rosiglitazone, which are insulin-sensitizing agents.
